name: sociallab
description: Run customer service from ChatGPT across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, X, Telegram and email: read conversations and contacts, reply on the customer's own channel, send approved templates, tag and assign customers, and run campaigns in your SocialLab account.

interface.longDescription:
SocialLab is a customer-communication platform for businesses in Saudi Arabia: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and more, with CRM, campaigns and an AI assistant. This plugin lets ChatGPT work in your SocialLab account on your behalf.

Ask ChatGPT to find a customer's conversation, summarise what they asked, and reply on the channel they wrote on (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok direct messages, X, Telegram, email or your website chat, where your account has that channel); to send an approved WhatsApp template or an interactive message; to tag customers, add an internal note or assign a conversation to a teammate; to look up a Salla abandoned cart or a product; and to read your dashboard and campaign performance. Campaigns are created as drafts and sent only when you confirm.

You sign in with your SocialLab account and approve access. Every action that changes something asks for your confirmation first. Account admins see every connected assistant and what it changed under Settings > Connected Apps, and can revoke access at any time; a revoked assistant is refused from its next request.

Works with SocialLab business accounts that have Partner API access turned on. Each reply follows its channel's reply window; on WhatsApp that is the 24-hour customer-service window, outside which an approved template is used.
capabilities: Read and search conversations on every channel
Reply on the customer's own channel and send approved templates
defaultPrompt: Show my most recent conversations in SocialLab.
Summarise what my latest customer asked for.
How did my latest SocialLab campaign perform?

positive.prompt: Show me my most recent WhatsApp conversations in SocialLab.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's three conversations (Abdulrazzak, Khalid 1, Khalid 2) with last activity, status and unread counts. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Open Abdulrazzak's conversation and summarise what he asked for.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads that customer's messages and summarises the request (an order-status question) and the assistant's reply. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Search my SocialLab messages for «طلب» and tell me which customers mentioned it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching messages grouped by customer, with counts and the latest match. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Reply to a customer after confirmation
positive.prompt: Reply to Abdulrazzak on WhatsApp: «شكراً لتواصلك، سنتابع طلبك الآن»
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation; after the user allows it, the message is sent to the test contact and ChatGPT reports it as sent. The test contacts are our team's phones. Free-form replies need the contact to have written in the last 24 hours (WhatsApp rule); otherwise the tool explains that an approved template is required.

positive.prompt: How did my latest SocialLab campaign perform?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest campaign and reports its delivery figures (sent, delivered, read, failed). Changes nothing.

negative.description: General writing with no account data needed
negative.prompt: Write me a marketing slogan for a coffee shop.
What is the weather in Riyadh?

negative.description: Payments are not a SocialLab capability; the plugin has no such tool

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Replies now go out on the channel the customer wrote on: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok direct messages, X, Telegram, email and the website chat, where the account has that channel. Email replies can take a subject.

ar-SA.subtitle: خدمة العملاء في كل قنواتك
ar-SA.description: سوشل لاب منصة تواصل مع العملاء للشركات في السعودية: واتساب وإنستقرام وماسنجر وتيك توك وغيرها، مع إدارة العملاء والحملات ومساعد ذكاء اصطناعي. تتيح هذه الإضافة لـ ChatGPT العمل في حسابك في سوشل لاب نيابة عنك: قراءة المحادثات والرد عليها في القناة التي كتب منها العميل (واتساب وإنستقرام وماسنجر ورسائل تيك توك الخاصة وإكس وتيليجرام والبريد الإلكتروني وويدجت المحادثة في موقعك، حسب القنوات المتاحة في حسابك)، وإرسال القوالب المعتمدة، ووسم العملاء وإسناد المحادثات، وقراءة التقارير وأداء الحملات. كل إجراء يغير شيئا يطلب موافقتك أولا، ويرى مدير الحساب كل مساعد مرتبط وما غيره في الإعدادات > التطبيقات المرتبطة ويستطيع إلغاء وصوله في أي وقت.
